title: pyrus campanulata
intro: Pyrus campanulata, commonly known as Taiwan pear, is a plant species native to Taiwan, belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus campanulata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
